comparison.objective: Level a rack shelf by relocating the single pull pin in the wrong hole; candidate tunes and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Shelf support, spring-pin retraction, hole alignment, and reinsertion differ from recessed hex-key use, collar calibration, and torque-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Shelf must rest level on all four pins; candidate requires two repeatable safe impacts and no collar drift.
comparison.reason: Both are maintenance adjustments, but the tested latching/alignment ability is materially different from response-based damper commissioning.
